recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 染色幾乎整片陽性（瀰漫性 B 細胞浸潤），CD138 顯示散在成群的漿細胞；輕鏈染色 kappa 大片陽性而 lambda 僅零星陽性，呈現 kappa 輕鏈限制性，符合伴隨漿細胞分化的單株性 B 細胞淋巴瘤（淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤）。
features: CD20: diffuse, near-confluent positivity replacing the marrow space
CD138: increased scattered and clustered plasma cells interspersed within the B-cell infiltrate
Kappa: strong, diffuse staining (cytoplasmic plus background) highlighting the plasmacytic component
Lambda: only rare scattered positive cells, indicating kappa light-chain restriction
Low-power views with bony trabeculae and fat spaces
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains on the bone marrow core biopsy show a diffuse infiltrate of CD20-positive B cells effacing the marrow space. CD138 highlights increased plasma cells present singly and in clusters within the infiltrate. Kappa in situ/immunostaining is diffusely positive, whereas lambda marks only rare scattered cells, indicating kappa light-chain restriction of the plasmacytic component. Findings indicate a clonal B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation and, together with morphology and MYD88 L265P, are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma. Kappa staining shows some background signal, which should be interpreted with care.

ddx.vs: MZL shares CD20+ B cells with monotypic plasma cells; distinction relies on clinical presentation, nodular/intrasinusoidal pattern and MYD88 status rather than this immunoprofile.
Myeloma shows sheets of light-chain-restricted CD138+ plasma cells without a diffuse CD20+ B-cell component.

ddx.dx: Reactive polyclonal plasmacytosis with lymphoid aggregates
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a normal kappa:lambda ratio (about 2:1) and B cells form small non-destructive aggregates.
